'''Vealo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] of the Tarisian [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]], who sent him to [[Brejik's Run Outpost]] in the [[Tularan Marsh]] to help with reconstruction efforts.
